labels.label: eligible

evidence.quote: Patients in Phase 1a must have a histologically or cytologically documented, advanced (metastatic and/or unresectable) solid tumor that has progressed on or after standard therapy (relapsed/refractory patients; patients must have failed at least one prior line of therapy)
Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status 0 to 2.

labels.note: Phase 1a escalation takes any advanced solid tumor progressing after a standard line; expansions are NSCLC, MSS-CRC, STS and uveal melanoma.

labels.label: possibly

evidence.quote: Histopathological or cytologically confirmed locally advanced or metastatic cancer that meets protocol-defined criteria
Disease that is not amenable to curative therapy, with prior therapies defined by specific tumor types
Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) Performance Status 0 or 1

labels.note: HER2 CAR-T; eligible tumor types and HER2 status not shown or tested.

labels.label: possibly

evidence.quote: A site of malignant disease causing symptoms, or for which symptoms are imminent, in which radiation may be used for relief or prophylaxis
Clinical or pathologic evidence of metastatic disease

labels.note: She feels well; whether a lung lesion threatens symptoms and needs palliative radiation is not stated.

labels.label: possibly

evidence.quote: Patients who are willing to forego standard therapies known to confer benefit
Patient must have undergone RNA testing in a Clinical Laboratory Improvement Act (CLIA) environment or must submit archival tissue to determine RNA overexpression of ADC TOIs by the TARGET Assay.
exceptions include patients with adenoid cystic cancer, salivary gland cancer, thyroid cancer, and parathyroid cancer, who are eligible

labels.note: Standard options remain after lenvatinib, so entry needs the forego-standard prong; Trop-2/Nectin-4/HER2 expression untested.

Target lesion(s) which are amenable to lattice therapy plan
ECOG Performance status ≤2

labels.label: eligible

evidence.quote: Have unresectable and/or metastatic solid tumors (with or without MSI-H/dMMR) refractory to or intolerant to previous SoC therapy or for which no SoC therapy exists
Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status score of 0 or 1
Presence of measurable disease according to RECIST version 1.1 except for Part A (Dose Escalation)

labels.note: Metastatic, progressing on lenvatinib (plain refractory wording), MSI-H not required.

labels.label: possibly

evidence.quote: Have a tumor that expresses SSR confirmed by SSR imaging.
Have a histological diagnosis of metastatic or locally advanced inoperable NET, NEC, or other solid tumors that have confirmed radiological progression.

labels.note: Other solid tumors allowed; somatostatin-receptor imaging never done.

labels.label: eligible

evidence.quote: Part 1 Dose-escalation: Patients must have histologically confirmed locally advanced, or metastatic solid tumors who have progressed after receiving appropriate lines of standard therapy known to potentially confer clinical benefit.
Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0-1.

labels.note: Part 1 takes any solid tumor progressing after standard therapy; no autoimmune disease; lenvatinib hypertension not stated as uncontrolled.

labels.label: possibly

evidence.quote: Participants must have documented histologically or cytologically confirmed advanced, unresectable/metastatic solid tumors, including NSCLC, HNSCC, TNBC, and HR+/HER2- breast cancer.
Participants must have an ECOG performance status of 0 to 1.

labels.note: "Including" list read as non-exclusive (run 22); whether thyroid cancer is accepted is not shown.

labels.label: possibly

evidence.quote: Other advanced or metastatic solid tumors with a documented activating FGFR3 alteration (mutation or fusion).
Participants must have progressed following, are intolerant of, or have no available standard-of-care therapy.
Patients must exhibit an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0 or 1

labels.note: Thyroid cancer fits only via an activating FGFR3 alteration, which was not reported.
